 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::count</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
/**
 * Assume /etc/myapp/application.ini contains:
 * [common]
 * application.name = "MyApp"
 * database.host    = "localhost"
 * database.port    = 3306
 */

// Only the top-level entries ("application" and "database") are counted
var_dump(count($config));
var_dump($config->count());
?>
]]>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-config-ini.current" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Config_Ini::current</refname>
<refpurpose>Get current entry value</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>mixed</type><methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::current</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Returns the value of the current configuration entry during iteration. Array values are wrapped in a <classname>Yaf_Config_Abstract</classname> object.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>The value of the current entry, or &false; if the position is invalid.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::current</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
/**
 * Assume /etc/myapp/application.ini contains:
 * [common]
 * application.name = "MyApp"
 * version          = "1.0"
 */
$config = new Yaf_Config_Ini('/etc/myapp/application.ini', 'common');

$config->rewind();
while ($config->valid()) {
    $value = $config->current();
    if ($value instanceof Yaf_Config_Abstract) {
        echo $config->key(), " => <config section>\n";
    } else {
        echo $config->key(), " => ", $value, "\n";
    }
    $config->next();
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
application => <config section>
version => 1.0
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::key</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::next</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::rewind</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::valid</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-config-ini.get" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Config_Ini::get</refname>
<refpurpose>Retrieve a configuration value</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>mixed</type><methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::get</methodname>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>string</type><parameter>name</parameter><initializer>NULL</initializer></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Retrieves a configuration value by name. Dot notation (e.g. <literal>database.host</literal>) can be used to access nested values. If <parameter>name</parameter> is omitted or &null;, the configuration object itself is returned.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The configuration key, optionally using dot notation for nested access.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>The value associated with <parameter>name</parameter>. Array values are wrapped in a <classname>Yaf_Config_Ini</classname> object. Returns &null; if the key does not exist, or the configuration object itself when <parameter>name</parameter> is &null;.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::get</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
/**
 * Assume /etc/myapp/application.ini contains:
 * [common]
 * application.name = "MyApp"
 * database.host    = "localhost"
 * database.port    = 3306
 */
$config = new Yaf_Config_Ini('/etc/myapp/application.ini', 'common');

// Dot notation for nested access
echo $config->get('database.host'), "\n";

// Array values are wrapped in a Yaf_Config_Ini object
echo $config->get('database')->port, "\n";

// No argument: the configuration object itself is returned
echo $config->get()->application->name, "\n";

var_dump($config->get('missing.key'));
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
localhost
3306
MyApp
NULL
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::set</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::toArray</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

  </methodsynopsis>

 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">

   <title><methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::__isset</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
/**
 * Assume /etc/myapp/application.ini contains:
 * [common]
 * application.name = "MyApp"
 * database.host    = "localhost"
 * database.port    = 3306
 */
$config = new Yaf_Config_Ini('/etc/myapp/application.ini', 'common');

var_dump(isset($config->database));
var_dump($config->__isset('database'));
var_dump(isset($config->cache));
?>

 * [common]

$config = new Yaf_Config_Ini('/etc/myapp/application.ini', 'common');

$config->rewind();

   <methodparam><type>mixed</type><parameter>name</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Checks whether a configuration key exists. This method is an alias of <methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::__isset</methodname> and is called when <literal>isset()</literal> is used with array syntax on a configuration object.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The configuration key to check.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">

 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::offsetExists</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
/**
 * Assume /etc/myapp/application.ini contains:
 * [common]
 * application.name = "MyApp"
 * database.host    = "localhost"
 * database.port    = 3306
 */

var_dump(isset($config['cache']));
?>
]]>

bool(true)
bool(true)
bool(false)
]]>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-config-ini.offsetset" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Config_Ini::offsetSet</refname>
<refpurpose>Set a configuration value (ArrayAccess)</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>void</type><methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::offsetSet</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>mixed</type><parameter>name</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam><type>mixed</type><parameter>value</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Attempts to set a configuration value using array syntax. This method is an alias of <methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::set</methodname>. Since <classname>Yaf_Config_Ini</classname> is always read-only, it always fails and emits a warning.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The configuration key to set.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>value</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The value to assign.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>No value is returned. A warning is emitted, because <classname>Yaf_Config_Ini</classname> is read-only.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::offsetSet</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
/**
 * Assume /etc/myapp/application.ini contains:
 * [common]
 * application.name = "MyApp"
 * database.host    = "localhost"
 * database.port    = 3306
 */
$config = new Yaf_Config_Ini('/etc/myapp/application.ini', 'common');

// Yaf_Config_Ini is read-only: a warning is emitted and the value is kept
$config['database.host'] = '192.0.2.10';

echo $config['database.host'], "\n";
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
localhost
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::set</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::offsetGet</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::readonly</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-config-ini.offsetunset" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Config_Ini::offsetUnset</refname>
<refpurpose>Remove a key (ArrayAccess)</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>void</type><methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::offsetUnset</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>mixed</type><parameter>name</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Removes a configuration entry by key. This method is called when <literal>unset()</literal> is used with array syntax on a configuration object.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The configuration key to remove.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>No value is returned. A warning is emitted if the configuration is read-only.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::offsetUnset</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
/**
 * Assume /etc/myapp/application.ini contains:
 * [common]
 * application.name = "MyApp"
 * database.host    = "localhost"
 * database.port    = 3306
 */
$config = new Yaf_Config_Ini('/etc/myapp/application.ini', 'common');

// Yaf_Config_Ini is read-only: a warning is emitted, nothing is removed
unset($config['database']);

var_dump(isset($config['database']));
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
bool(true)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-config-ini.readonly" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Config_Ini::readonly</refname>
<refpurpose>Check if configuration is read-only</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>bool</type><methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::readonly</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Checks whether the configuration is read-only. <classname>Yaf_Config_Ini</classname> is always read-only.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Always returns &true;.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::readonly</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$config = new Yaf_Config_Ini('/etc/myapp/application.ini', 'common');

// Yaf_Config_Ini is always read-only
var_dump($config->readonly());

// Attempts to write are rejected (and a warning is emitted)
var_dump($config->set('version', '2.0'));
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
bool(true)
bool(false)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::set</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-config-ini.rewind" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Config_Ini::rewind</refname>
<refpurpose>Reset iterator to first entry</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>void</type><methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::rewind</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Rewinds the internal iterator to the first configuration entry.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>No value is returned.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::rewind</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
/**
 * Assume /etc/myapp/application.ini contains:
 * [common]
 * application.name = "MyApp"
 * version          = "1.0"
 */
$config = new Yaf_Config_Ini('/etc/myapp/application.ini', 'common');

$config->next();
echo $config->key(), "\n";

$config->rewind();
echo $config->key(), "\n";
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
version
application
]]>
   </screen>

   <member><methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::valid</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

 * database.port    = 3306
 */
$config = new Yaf_Config_Ini('/etc/myapp/application.ini', 'common');

// Read-only: the assignment always fails, and a warning is emitted
var_dump($config->set('database.host', '192.0.2.10'));

echo $config->get('database.host'), "\n";
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
bool(false)
localhost
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::get</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::readonly</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-config-ini.valid" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Config_Ini::valid</refname>
<refpurpose>Check if current position is valid</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>bool</type><methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::valid</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Checks whether the current iterator position is valid.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns &true; if the current position is valid, &false; otherwise.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::valid</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
/**
 * Assume /etc/myapp/application.ini contains:
 * [common]
 * application.name = "MyApp"
 * version          = "1.0"
 */
$config = new Yaf_Config_Ini('/etc/myapp/application.ini', 'common');

$config->rewind();
var_dump($config->valid());

$config->next();
var_dump($config->valid());

$config->next(); // past the last entry
var_dump($config->valid());
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
bool(true)
bool(true)
bool(false)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::current</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::key</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::next</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Config_Ini::rewind</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

   <modifier>public</modifier><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::__construct</methodname>

   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>bool</type><parameter>readonly</parameter><initializer>false</initializer></methodparam>

 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>values</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>An array of configuration values.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>readonly</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>Whether the configuration should be read-only. Defaults to &false; (writable).</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>No value is returned.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::__construct</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$config = new Yaf_Config_Simple([
    'application' => ['name' => 'MyApp', 'env' => 'production'],
    'database'    => ['host' => 'localhost', 'port' => 3306],
]);

echo $config->application->name, "\n";
echo $config->database->host, "\n";

// The optional second argument makes the configuration read-only
$frozen = new Yaf_Config_Simple(['env' => 'testing'], true);
var_dump($frozen->readonly());
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
MyApp
localhost
bool(true)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 </refsect1>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-config-simple.current" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Config_Simple::current</refname>
<refpurpose>Get current entry value</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>mixed</type><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::current</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Returns the value of the current configuration entry during iteration. Array values are wrapped in a <classname>Yaf_Config_Abstract</classname> object.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>The value of the current entry, or &false; if the position is invalid.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::current</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$config = new Yaf_Config_Simple([
    'application' => ['name' => 'MyApp'],
    'version'     => '1.0',
]);

$config->rewind();
while ($config->valid()) {
    $value = $config->current();
    if ($value instanceof Yaf_Config_Abstract) {
        echo $config->key(), " => <config node>\n";
    } else {
        echo $config->key(), " => ", $value, "\n";
    }
    $config->next();
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
application => <config node>
version => 1.0
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::key</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::next</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::rewind</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::valid</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-config-simple.get" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Config_Simple::get</refname>
<refpurpose>Retrieve a configuration value</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>mixed</type><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::get</methodname>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>string</type><parameter>name</parameter><initializer>NULL</initializer></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Retrieves a configuration value by name. If <parameter>name</parameter> is omitted or &null;, the configuration object itself is returned.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The configuration key to retrieve.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>The value associated with <parameter>name</parameter>. Array values are wrapped in a <classname>Yaf_Config_Simple</classname> object. Returns &null; if the key does not exist, or the configuration object itself when <parameter>name</parameter> is &null;.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::get</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$config = new Yaf_Config_Simple([
    'application' => ['name' => 'MyApp'],
    'database'    => ['host' => 'localhost'],
]);

// Array values are wrapped in a Yaf_Config_Simple object
echo $config->get('database')->host, "\n";
echo $config->get('application')->name, "\n";
var_dump($config->get('missing'));
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
localhost
MyApp
NULL
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-config-simple.isset" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Config_Simple::__isset</refname>
<refpurpose>Check if a key exists</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>bool</type><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::__isset</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>name</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Checks whether a configuration key exists. This method is invoked when <literal>isset()</literal> is used on a configuration object.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The configuration key to check.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns &true; if the key exists, &false; otherwise.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::__isset</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$config = new Yaf_Config_Simple([
    'application' => ['name' => 'MyApp'],
    'database'    => ['host' => 'localhost'],
]);

var_dump(isset($config->application));
var_dump($config->__isset('application'));
var_dump(isset($config->cache));
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
bool(true)
bool(true)
bool(false)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::get</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::offsetExists</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-config-simple.key" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Config_Simple::key</refname>
<refpurpose>Get current entry key</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>mixed</type><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::key</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Returns the key of the current configuration entry during iteration.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>The key of the current entry (string or integer), or &false; if the position is invalid.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::key</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$config = new Yaf_Config_Simple([
    'application' => ['name' => 'MyApp'],
    'database'    => ['host' => 'localhost'],
]);

for ($config->rewind(); $config->valid(); $config->next()) {
    echo $config->key(), "\n";
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
application
database
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::current</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::next</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::rewind</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::valid</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-config-simple.next" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Config_Simple::next</refname>
<refpurpose>Advance to next entry</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>void</type><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::next</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Moves the internal iterator to the next configuration entry.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>No value is returned.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::next</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$config = new Yaf_Config_Simple([
    'application' => ['name' => 'MyApp'],
    'database'    => ['host' => 'localhost'],
]);

$config->rewind();
echo $config->key(), "\n";

$config->next();
echo $config->key(), "\n";

$config->next(); // past the last entry
var_dump($config->valid());
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
application
database
bool(false)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::current</methodname></member>

   <member><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::rewind</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::valid</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-config-simple.offsetget" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Config_Simple::offsetGet</refname>
<refpurpose>Get a value (ArrayAccess)</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>mixed</type><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::offsetGet</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>mixed</type><parameter>name</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Retrieves a configuration value by key. This method is an alias of <methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::get</methodname> and is called when array syntax is used to read a configuration object.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The configuration key to retrieve.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>The value associated with <parameter>name</parameter>, or &null; if the key does not exist.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::offsetGet</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$config = new Yaf_Config_Simple([
    'application' => ['name' => 'MyApp'],
    'database'    => ['host' => 'localhost'],
]);

// Array values are wrapped in a Yaf_Config_Simple object
echo $config['application']->name, "\n";
echo $config['database']['host'], "\n";
var_dump($config['missing']);
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
MyApp
localhost
NULL
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">

 </refsect1>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-config-simple.offsetset" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Config_Simple::offsetSet</refname>
<refpurpose>Set a configuration value (ArrayAccess)</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>void</type><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::offsetSet</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>mixed</type><parameter>name</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam><type>mixed</type><parameter>value</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Sets a configuration value using array syntax. This method is an alias of <methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::set</methodname>. The assignment fails silently if the configuration is read-only.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The configuration key to set.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>value</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The value to assign.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>No value is returned. The assignment fails if the configuration is read-only.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::offsetSet</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$config = new Yaf_Config_Simple(['env' => 'development']);

// Writable by default
$config['env'] = 'production';
$config['cache'] = ['enable' => true];
echo $config['env'], "\n";
var_dump($config['cache']['enable']);

// Assignments to a read-only configuration fail silently
$frozen = new Yaf_Config_Simple(['env' => 'development'], true);
$frozen['env'] = 'production';
echo $frozen['env'], "\n";
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
production
bool(true)
development
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::set</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::offsetGet</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::offsetUnset</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-config-simple.offsetunset" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Config_Simple::offsetUnset</refname>
<refpurpose>Remove a key (ArrayAccess)</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>void</type><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::offsetUnset</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>mixed</type><parameter>name</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Removes a configuration entry by key. This method is called when <literal>unset()</literal> is used with array syntax on a configuration object.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The configuration key to remove.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>No value is returned. A warning is emitted if the configuration is read-only.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::offsetUnset</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$config = new Yaf_Config_Simple([
    'cache' => ['enable' => true],
    'env'   => 'development',
]);

unset($config['cache']);
var_dump(isset($config['cache']));

// Read-only configurations cannot be modified: a warning is emitted
$frozen = new Yaf_Config_Simple(['env' => 'development'], true);
unset($frozen['env']);
var_dump(isset($frozen['env']));
?>
]]>

bool(false)
bool(true)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-config-simple.set" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Config_Simple::set</refname>
<refpurpose>Set a configuration value</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>bool</type><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::set</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>name</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam><type>mixed</type><parameter>value</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Sets a configuration value. Fails and returns &false; if the configuration is read-only.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The configuration key to set.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>value</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The value to assign.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns &true; on success, or &false; if the configuration is read-only.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::set</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$config = new Yaf_Config_Simple(['env' => 'development']);

var_dump($config->set('env', 'production'));
echo $config->env, "\n";

// Read-only configurations reject the modification
$frozen = new Yaf_Config_Simple(['env' => 'development'], true);
var_dump($frozen->set('env', 'production'));
echo $frozen->env, "\n";
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
bool(true)
production
bool(false)
development
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::get</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Config_Simple::readonly</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>

    'database'    => ['host' => 'localhost'],
]);

var_dump($config->valid());
?>

bool(true)
bool(false)

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-controller-abstract.construct" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::__construct</refname>
  <refpurpose>Constructor of Yaf_Controller_Abstract</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <constructorsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::__construct</methodname>
   <void />
  </constructorsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   <methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::__construct</methodname> is
   called by Yaf when a controller object is created during dispatching.
   It takes no arguments, and users should not call it directly. Since
   it is not intended to be overridden with custom logic,
   <methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::init</methodname> is provided as
   the userland initialization hook instead.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   No value is returned.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::__construct</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class IndexController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    // __construct() is called by Yaf_Dispatcher when the controller
    // is instantiated during dispatching, and should be neither
    // called manually nor overridden. Define init() instead:

    public function init() {
        // by the time init() runs, the dispatcher has already wired
        // up the controller: the request, response and view engine
        // are all available
        var_dump($this->getRequest() instanceof Yaf_Request_Abstract);
        var_dump($this->getResponse() instanceof Yaf_Response_Abstract);
        var_dump($this->getView() instanceof Yaf_View_Interface);
    }

    public function indexAction() {
        // ...
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
bool(true)
bool(true)
bool(true)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::init</methodname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

   <modifier>protected</modifier> <type class="union"><type>bool</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::display</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>tpl</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type class="union"><type>array</type><type>null</type></type><parameter>parameters</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Renders the view script <parameter>tpl</parameter> and sends the
   result directly, unlike
   <methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::render</methodname>,
   which returns the rendered output instead. Auto-rendering
   of the default action template is controlled by
   <methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::autoRender</methodname>.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>tpl</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      The view script name, relative to the view path.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>parameters</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      An associative array of variables to export to the
      view script for this rendering, overriding those
      assigned through the view engine.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns &true; on success, or &false; / &null; on failure.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::display</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class ProductController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function listAction() {
        // render product/list.phtml and send the result directly
        // to the client, exporting $products to this rendering
        $this->display("product/list.phtml", array(
            "products" => array("yaf", "php"),
        ));
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
  <example>
   <title>Template example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<!-- application/views/product/list.phtml -->
<ul>
<?php foreach ($products as $product) { ?>
    <li><?php echo $product; ?></li>
<?php } ?>
</ul>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
<ul>
    <li>yaf</li>
    <li>php</li>
</ul>
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::render</methodname></member>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::autoRender</methodname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-controller-abstract.forward" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::forward</refname>
  <refpurpose>Forward the current request to another action</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>bool</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::forward</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>action</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type class="union"><type>array</type><type>null</type></type><parameter>parameters</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>bool</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::forward</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>controller</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>action</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type class="union"><type>array</type><type>null</type></type><parameter>parameters</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>bool</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::forward</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>module</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>controller</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>action</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type class="union"><type>array</type><type>null</type></type><parameter>parameters</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Forward the current request to another action. The target is
   determined from the number and types of the arguments:
  </simpara>
  <simplelist>
   <member><parameter>action</parameter> only: forward to another action of the current controller.</member>
   <member><parameter>controller</parameter> and <parameter>action</parameter>: forward to another controller.</member>
   <member><parameter>module</parameter>, <parameter>controller</parameter> and <parameter>action</parameter>: forward to another module.</member>
   <member>The optional <parameter>parameters</parameter> array carries invocation arguments retrievable with <methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getParam</methodname>.</member>
  </simplelist>
  <note>
   <simpara>
    This method does not switch to the destination action immediately;
    the switch takes place after the current flow finishes. To hand over
    control right away, return from the current action method (returning
    &false; also tells Yaf not to auto-render the current view).
   </simpara>
  </note>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>module</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      The destination module name. If the current module is given, it is
      used as is.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>controller</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      The destination controller name.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>action</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      The destination action name.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>parameters</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      Invocation arguments for the destination action, retrievable
      with <methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getParam</methodname>.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns &true; on success, or &false; / &null; on failure.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::forward</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class IndexController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function indexAction() {
        $logined = $_SESSION["login"];
        if (!$logined) {
            $this->forward("login", array("from" => "Index")); // forward to the login action
            return false; // this is important, it ends the current flow
                          // and tells Yaf not to auto-render
        }

        // other processes
    }

    public function loginAction() {
        echo "login, redirected from ", $this->_request->getParam("from") , " action";
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
   login, redirected from Index action
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getParam</methodname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-controller-abstract.getinvokearg" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::getInvokeArg</refname>
  <refpurpose>Retrieve one action invocation argument</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>string</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::getInvokeArg</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>name</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Returns a single invocation argument of the current action, given its
   name. Invocation arguments are passed to the action through
   <methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::forward</methodname>.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      The name of the invocation argument to retrieve.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   The argument value, or &null; if it does not exist.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::getInvokeArg</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class UserController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function indexAction() {
        // forward to the profile action of this controller,
        // carrying invocation arguments
        $this->forward("profile", array("name" => "laruence"));
        return false; // ends the current flow
    }

    public function profileAction() {
        // retrieve one invocation argument by name
        var_dump($this->getInvokeArg("name"));
        var_dump($this->getInvokeArg("missing"));
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
string(8) "laruence"
NULL
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::getInvokeArgs</methodname></member>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::forward</methodname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-controller-abstract.getinvokeargs" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::getInvokeArgs</refname>
  <refpurpose>Retrieve all action invocation arguments</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>array</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::getInvokeArgs</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Returns all invocation arguments of the current action, as an array
   keyed by argument name. Invocation arguments are passed to the action
   through <methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::forward</methodname>.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   An array of invocation arguments, or &null; if none were given.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::getInvokeArgs</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class ProductController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function indexAction() {
        $this->forward("list", array("category" => "book", "page" => 2));
        return false; // ends the current flow
    }

    public function listAction() {
        // all invocation arguments of the current action
        var_dump($this->getInvokeArgs());
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
array(2) {
  ["category"]=>
  string(4) "book"
  ["page"]=>
  int(2)
}
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::getInvokeArg</methodname></member>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::forward</methodname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

  <refpurpose>Retrieve current request object</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::getRequest</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>

   Returns the <classname>Yaf_Request_Abstract</classname> instance associated with this controller.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">

 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;

  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">

   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class IndexController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function indexAction() {
        $request = $this->getRequest();
        var_dump($request->getModuleName());

    }
}
?>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-controller-abstract.getresponse" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::getResponse</refname>
  <refpurpose>Retrieve current response object</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Response_Abstract</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::getResponse</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Returns the <classname>Yaf_Response_Abstract</classname> instance associated with this controller.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   A <classname>Yaf_Response_Abstract</classname> instance, or &null; if no response is available.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::getResponse</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class ProductController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function apiAction() {
        // build the answer ourselves, no template needed
        Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->disableView();

        $response = $this->getResponse();
        $response->setHeader("Content-Type", "application/json");
        $response->setBody(json_encode(array("name" => "yaf")));
        // Yaf sends the body after the dispatch loop finishes
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::getRequest</methodname></member>
    <member><classname>Yaf_Response_Abstract</classname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-controller-abstract.init" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::init</refname>
  <refpurpose>Controller initializer</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>void</type><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::init</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   <methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::__construct</methodname> is not
   meant to be overridden with custom logic, so
   <methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::init</methodname> is provided as
   the userland initialization hook. If it is defined in a controller, it
   is called right after the controller object is instantiated.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   No value is returned.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::init</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class IndexController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    // init() is called right after the controller is instantiated,
    // before any action is dispatched
    public function init() {
        $this->getView()->assign("sitename", "Yaf Tutorial");
    }

    public function indexAction() {
        // ...
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::__construct</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-controller-abstract.initview" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::initView</refname>
  <refpurpose>Initialize the view and return it</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_View_Interface</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::initView</methodname>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type class="union"><type>array</type><type>null</type></type><parameter>options</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Returns the view engine bound to this controller. The view engine is
   initialized by the <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> during
   dispatching, using the template path set for the current controller.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>options</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      Options passed to the view engine, see
      <methodname>Yaf_View_Simple::__construct</methodname>.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   A <classname>Yaf_View_Interface</classname> instance on success, or
   &null; on failure.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::initView</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class ProductController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function indexAction() {
        // fetch the view engine bound to this controller, initialized
        // with its template path, e.g. application/views/;
        // options would be forwarded to the view engine, see
        // Yaf_View_Simple::__construct()
        $view = $this->initView();
        $view->assign("products", array("yaf", "php"));
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::getView</methodname></member>
    <member><classname>Yaf_View_Interface</classname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-controller-abstract.redirect" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::redirect</refname>
  <refpurpose>Redirect to a URL</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>bool</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::redirect</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>url</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Redirects the client to another URL by sending a
   <literal>Location</literal> header (HTTP status 302).
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>url</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      The URL to redirect to.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns &true; on success, or &false; / &null; on failure.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::redirect</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class AccountController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function loginAction() {
        if (!$this->getRequest()->getParam("user")) {
            // send a Location header with HTTP status 302
            $this->redirect("http://www.example.com/account/login/");
            return false; // skip auto-rendering
        }
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-controller-abstract.render" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::render</refname>
  <refpurpose>Render view template</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>protected</modifier> <type class="union"><type>string</type><type>bool</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::render</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>tpl</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type class="union"><type>array</type><type>null</type></type><parameter>parameters</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Renders the view script <parameter>tpl</parameter> and returns the
   output, unlike
   <methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::display</methodname>.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>tpl</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      The view script name, relative to the view path.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>parameters</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      An associative array of variables to export to the view
      script for this rendering.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   The rendered output as a &string; on success, or &false; on
   failure.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::render</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class ProductController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function indexAction() {
        // do not auto-render the default template
        Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->disableView();

        // render product/index.phtml and return the output
        // instead of sending it directly (as display() would)
        $html = $this->render("product/index.phtml", array(
            "products" => array("yaf", "php"),
        ));

        // post-process and set it as the response body
        $this->getResponse()->setBody($html);
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::display</methodname></member>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::autoRender</methodname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-controller-abstract.setviewpath" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::setViewpath</refname>
  <refpurpose>Set the view path</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>bool</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::setViewpath</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>view_directory</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Sets the template directory of the view engine bound to this
   controller.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>view_directory</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      The directory that holds the view templates.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns &true; on success, or &false; / &null; on failure.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::setViewpath</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class ProductController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function init() {
        // from now on templates of this controller are looked up
        // under application/themes/dark/views/
        $this->setViewpath(APPLICATION_PATH . "/themes/dark/views");
    }

    public function indexAction() {
        // renders application/themes/dark/views/product/index.phtml
        $this->display("product/index.phtml");
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;

   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.autorender" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::autoRender</refname>
  <refpurpose>Switch on/off autorendering</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Dispatcher</type><type>bool</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::autoRender</methodname>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type class="union"><type>bool</type><type>null</type></type><parameter>flag</parameter><initializer>null</initializer></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> will render the view
   automatically after dispatching an incoming request. You can prevent
   the rendering by calling this method with
   <parameter>flag</parameter> &false;.
  </simpara>
  <note>
   <simpara>
    You can also simply return &false; in an action to prevent the
    auto-rendering of that action only.
   </simpara>
  </note>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>flag</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      Whether to enable auto-rendering.
     </simpara>
     <note>
      <simpara>
       Since Yaf 2.2.0, if this parameter is not given, the current state
       is returned instead.
      </simpara>
     </note>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns the <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> object itself when
   <parameter>flag</parameter> is given, or a &boolean; indicating whether
   auto-rendering is enabled when it is not.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>Yaf_Dispatcher::autoRender</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class IndexController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract {
     /* init method will be called as soon as a controller is initialized */
     public function init() {
         if ($this->getRequest()->isXmlHttpRequest()) {
             //do not call render for ajax request
             //we will output a json string
             Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->autoRender(FALSE);
         }
     }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::flushInstantly</methodname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.catchexception" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::catchException</refname>
  <refpurpose>Switch on/off exception catching</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Dispatcher</type><type>bool</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::catchException</methodname>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type class="union"><type>bool</type><type>null</type></type><parameter>flag</parameter><initializer>null</initializer></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   While
   <link linkend="configuration.yaf.dispatcher.throwexception">application.dispatcher.throwException</link>
   is on (which can also be enabled by calling
   <methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::throwException</methodname>), Yaf throws
   exceptions when errors occur instead of triggering errors.
  </simpara>
  <simpara>
   If exception catching is additionally enabled via this method (or via
   <link linkend="configuration.yaf.dispatcher.catchexception">application.dispatcher.catchException</link>),
   all uncaught exceptions are caught and dispatched to
   <literal>ErrorController::error</literal>, if one is defined.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>flag</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      Whether Yaf should catch uncaught exceptions and dispatch them to
      <literal>ErrorController::error</literal>.
     </simpara>
     <note>
      <simpara>
       Since Yaf 2.2.0, if this parameter is not given, the current state
       is returned instead.
      </simpara>
     </note>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns the <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> object itself when
   <parameter>flag</parameter> is given, or a &boolean; indicating whether
   exception catching is enabled when it is not.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>Yaf_Dispatcher::catchException</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
/* if you defined an ErrorController like following */
class ErrorController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract {
     /**
      * you can also call Yaf_Request_Abstract::getException to get the
      * uncaught exception.
      */
     public function errorAction($exception) {
        /* an error occurred */
        switch ($exception->getCode()) {
            case YAF_ERR_NOTFOUND_MODULE:
            case YAF_ERR_NOTFOUND_CONTROLLER:
            case YAF_ERR_NOTFOUND_ACTION:
            case YAF_ERR_NOTFOUND_VIEW:
                echo 404, ":", $exception->getMessage();
                break;
            default :
                $message = $exception->getMessage();
                echo 0, ":", $exception->getMessage();
                break;
        }
     }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
/* now if some error occurs, assuming accessing a non-existent controller
   (or you can throw an exception yourself): */
404:Could not find controller script **/application/controllers/No-exists-controller.php
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::throwException</methodname></member>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setErrorHandler</methodname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.construct" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::__construct</refname>
  <refpurpose>Yaf_Dispatcher constructor</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <constructorsynopsis>
   <modifier>private</modifier> <methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::__construct</methodname>
   <void />
  </constructorsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> implements the singleton pattern,
   so the constructor is private. Use
   <methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance</methodname> to retrieve the
   dispatcher instance, which is created by
   <classname>Yaf_Application</classname>.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   &return.void;
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> is a singleton</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$app = new Yaf_Application(dirname(__FILE__) . "/conf/application.ini");

// Yaf_Dispatcher implements the singleton pattern, so its constructor is
// private. Retrieve the instance with Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()
// instead of calling `new`.
$dispatcher = Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance();

var_dump($dispatcher instanceof Yaf_Dispatcher);
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
bool(true)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance</methodname></member>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Application::getDispatcher</methodname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.disableview" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::disableView</refname>
  <refpurpose>Disable view rendering</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Dispatcher</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::disableView</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Turn off view rendering. This is typically used for actions that
   generate their own output, such as actions returning JSON data.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns the <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> object itself on
   success, or &null; if the application is not initialized.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::disableView</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$app = new Yaf_Application(dirname(__FILE__) . "/conf/application.ini");

// Turn off view rendering globally, every action is expected to produce
// its output itself (e.g. a JSON API service).
Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->disableView();

$app->run();
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.dispatch" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::dispatch</refname>
  <refpurpose>Dispatch a request</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Response_Abstract</type><type>null</type><type>false</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::dispatch</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><parameter>request</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   This method does the heavy work of the
   <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname>. It takes a request object.
  </simpara>
  <para>
   The dispatch process has three distinct events:
   <simplelist>
    <member>Routing</member>
    <member>Dispatching</member>
    <member>Response</member>
   </simplelist>
   Routing takes place exactly once, using the values in the request object
   when <methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::dispatch</methodname> is called.
   Dispatching takes place in a loop; a request may either indicate
   multiple actions to dispatch, or the controller or a plugin may reset
   the request object to force additional actions to dispatch (see
   <classname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract</classname>). When all is done, the
   <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> returns a response.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>request</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      A <classname>Yaf_Request_Abstract</classname> instance to dispatch.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   The <classname>Yaf_Response_Abstract</classname> instance on success,
   &false; on failure, or &null; if the application is not initialized.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::dispatch</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$app = new Yaf_Application(dirname(__FILE__) . "/conf/application.ini");
$app->bootstrap();

// Build a request pointing at ProductController::detailAction and
// dispatch it manually.
$request = new Yaf_Request_Http("/product/detail/id/42");

$response = Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->dispatch($request);

if ($response instanceof Yaf_Response_Abstract) {
    $response->response();
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Application::run</methodname></member>
    <member><classname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract</classname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>
