<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.enableview" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::enableView</refname>
  <refpurpose>Enable view rendering</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Dispatcher</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::enableView</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Turn on view rendering. This is the opposite of
   <methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::disableView</methodname>.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns the <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> object itself on
   success, or &null; if the application is not initialized.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::enableView</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class ApiPlugin extends Yaf_Plugin_Abstract
{
    public function routerStartup(Yaf_Request_Abstract $request, Yaf_Response_Abstract $response)
    {
        $dispatcher = Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance();

        if ($request->getModuleName() === "Api") {
            // API actions emit JSON themselves, no view rendering wanted
            $dispatcher->disableView();
        } else {
            $dispatcher->enableView();
        }
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::disableView</methodname></member>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::autoRender</methodname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.flushinstantly" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::flushInstantly</refname>
  <refpurpose>Switch on/off the instant flushing</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Dispatcher</type><type>bool</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::flushInstantly</methodname>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type class="union"><type>bool</type><type>null</type></type><parameter>flag</parameter><initializer>null</initializer></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Switch on/off instant flushing. When enabled (the default), the
   response body is flushed to the client immediately once it is set by
   <methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::setBody</methodname>.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>flag</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      Whether to flush the response body instantly.
     </simpara>
     <note>
      <simpara>
       Since Yaf 2.2.0, if this parameter is not given, the current state
       is returned instead.
      </simpara>
     </note>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns the <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> object itself when
   <parameter>flag</parameter> is given, or a &boolean; indicating the current
   state when it is not.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::flushInstantly</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$app = new Yaf_Application(dirname(__FILE__) . "/conf/application.ini");

$dispatcher = Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance();

// Do not flush the response body to the client as soon as it is set
$dispatcher->flushInstantly(false);

// Since Yaf 2.2.0, calling it without arguments queries the current state
var_dump($dispatcher->flushInstantly());

$app->run();
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
bool(false)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::returnResponse</methodname></member>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::setBody</methodname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.getdefaultaction" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getDefaultAction</refname>
  <refpurpose>Retrieve the default action name</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>string</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getDefaultAction</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Get the default action name, which is used when an action name can not
   be extracted from the request URI. Defaults to
   <literal>"index"</literal>.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   The default action name, or &null; if the application is not
   initialized.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getDefaultAction</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$app = new Yaf_Application(dirname(__FILE__) . "/conf/application.ini");

$dispatcher = Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance();

var_dump($dispatcher->getDefaultAction());

$dispatcher->setDefaultAction("main");
var_dump($dispatcher->getDefaultAction());
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
string(5) "index"
string(4) "main"
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setDefaultAction</methodname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.getdefaultmodule" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getDefaultModule</refname>
  <refpurpose>Retrieve the default module name</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>string</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getDefaultModule</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Get the default module name, which is used when a module name can not
   be extracted from the request URI. Defaults to
   <literal>"Index"</literal>.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   The default module name, or &null; if the application is not
   initialized.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getDefaultModule</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$app = new Yaf_Application(dirname(__FILE__) . "/conf/application.ini");

var_dump(Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->getDefaultModule());
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
string(5) "Index"
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setDefaultModule</methodname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.getrequest" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getRequest</refname>
  <refpurpose>Retrieve the request instance</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getRequest</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Retrieve the request object held by the dispatcher.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   The <classname>Yaf_Request_Abstract</classname> instance, or &null; if
   the application is not initialized.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getRequest</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class IndexController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function indexAction()
    {
        $request = Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->getRequest();

        // The dispatcher holds the very same request object that is
        // passed to the controller
        var_dump($request === $this->getRequest());

        return false;
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
bool(true)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setRequest</methodname></member>
    <member><classname>Yaf_Request_Abstract</classname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.getresponse" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getResponse</refname>
  <refpurpose>Get the response object</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Response_Abstract</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getResponse</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Retrieve the <classname>Yaf_Response_Abstract</classname> instance used
   by the dispatcher.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   The <classname>Yaf_Response_Abstract</classname> instance, or &null; if
   the application is not initialized.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getResponse</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class CharsetPlugin extends Yaf_Plugin_Abstract
{
    public function preDispatch(Yaf_Request_Abstract $request, Yaf_Response_Abstract $response)
    {
        // Same response object as the one held by the dispatcher
        Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->getResponse()->setHeader(
            "Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8"
        );
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setResponse</methodname></member>
    <member><classname>Yaf_Response_Abstract</classname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.getrouter" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getRouter</refname>
  <refpurpose>Retrieve router instance</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Router</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getRouter</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Retrieve the <classname>Yaf_Router</classname> instance used by the
   dispatcher to route requests.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   The <classname>Yaf_Router</classname> instance, or &null; if the
   application is not initialized.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getRouter</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class Bootstrap extends Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract
{
    public function _initRoute(Yaf_Dispatcher $dispatcher)
    {
        $router = $dispatcher->getRouter();

        // Route /product/42 to ProductController::detailAction
        $router->addRoute("product", new Yaf_Route_Rewrite(
            "product/:id",
            array("controller" => "product", "action" => "detail")
        ));
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><classname>Yaf_Router</classname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.initview" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::initView</refname>
  <refpurpose>Initialize view and return it</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_View_Interface</type><type>null</type><type>false</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::initView</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>templates_dir</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type class="union"><type>array</type><type>null</type></type><parameter>options</parameter><initializer>null</initializer></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Initialize and return a <classname>Yaf_View_Simple</classname> instance
   bound to the dispatcher, using the given template directory.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>templates_dir</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      The directory that holds the view templates.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>options</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      Options passed to the view engine, see
      <methodname>Yaf_View_Simple::__construct</methodname>.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   A <classname>Yaf_View_Interface</classname> instance on success, or
   &false; / &null; on failure.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::initView</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$app = new Yaf_Application(dirname(__FILE__) . "/conf/application.ini");

$view = Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->initView(
    dirname(__FILE__) . "/application/views",
    array("tpl_suffix" => ".html")
);

$view->assign("title", "Home");
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setView</methodname></member>
    <member><classname>Yaf_View_Simple</classname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.registerplugin" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::registerPlugin</refname>
  <refpurpose>Register a plugin</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Dispatcher</type><type>null</type><type>false</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::registerPlugin</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract</type><parameter>plugin</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Register a plugin (see <classname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract</classname>).
   Generally, plugins are registered in Bootstrap (see
   <classname>Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract</classname>).
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>plugin</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      A <classname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract</classname> instance.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns the <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> object itself on
   success, or &false; / &null; on failure.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>Yaf_Dispatcher::registerPlugin</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class Bootstrap extends Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract {
  public function _initPlugin(Yaf_Dispatcher $dispatcher) {
    /**
    * Yaf assumes plugin scripts under [application.directory] .  "/plugins" 
    * for this case, it will be:
    * [application.directory] . "/plugins/" . "User" . [application.ext]
    */ 
    $user = new UserPlugin();
    $dispatcher->registerPlugin($user);
  }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><classname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract</classname></member>
    <member><classname>Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract</classname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.returnresponse" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::returnResponse</refname>
  <refpurpose>Switch on/off returning the response</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Dispatcher</type><type>bool</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::returnResponse</methodname>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>bool</type><parameter>flag</parameter><initializer>false</initializer></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Switch whether
   <methodname>Yaf_Application::run</methodname> returns the response
   object instead of sending it to the client directly. When enabled,
   <literal>$response = $app->run()</literal> gives you the
   <classname>Yaf_Response_Abstract</classname> instance so it can be
   further manipulated. Available since Yaf 3.2.2.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>flag</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      Whether to return the response instead of sending it.
     </simpara>
     <note>
      <simpara>
       If this parameter is not given, the current state is returned
       instead.
      </simpara>
     </note>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns the <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> object itself when
   <parameter>flag</parameter> is given, or a &boolean; indicating the current
   state when it is not.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::returnResponse</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$app = new Yaf_Application(dirname(__FILE__) . "/conf/application.ini");

Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->returnResponse(true);

// $app->run() now returns the response instead of flushing it
$response = $app->run();

$response->setHeader("X-Generator", "Yaf");
$response->response();
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Application::run</methodname></member>
    <member><classname>Yaf_Response_Abstract</classname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.setdefaultaction" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setDefaultAction</refname>
  <refpurpose>Change default action name</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Dispatcher</type><type>null</type><type>false</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setDefaultAction</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>action</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Change the action name which is used when an action name can not be
   extracted from the request URI. The name is normalized to lowercase.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>action</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      The name of the action.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns the <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> object itself on
   success, or &false; if the application is not initialized.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setDefaultAction</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$app = new Yaf_Application(dirname(__FILE__) . "/conf/application.ini");

// Requests without an action part are now routed to "main" instead of
// "index", e.g. /user maps to UserController::mainAction
Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->setDefaultAction("main");

$app->run();
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setDefaultModule</methodname></member>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setDefaultController</methodname></member>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getDefaultAction</methodname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.setdefaultmodule" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setDefaultModule</refname>
  <refpurpose>Change default module name</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Dispatcher</type><type>null</type><type>false</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setDefaultModule</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>module</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Change the module name which is used when a module name can not be
   extracted from the request URI. The module must be a registered one,
   see <methodname>Yaf_Application::getModules</methodname>.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>module</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      The name of a registered module.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns the <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> object itself on
   success, &false; if the given module is not registered (and a
   <constant>YAF_ERR_TYPE_ERROR</constant> is triggered) or if the
   application is not initialized, or &null; otherwise.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="errors">
  &reftitle.errors;
  <simpara>
   Triggers a <constant>YAF_ERR_TYPE_ERROR</constant> error if
   <parameter>module</parameter> is not a registered module name.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setDefaultModule</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$app = new Yaf_Application(dirname(__FILE__) . "/conf/application.ini");

// "Home" must be a registered module, e.g. via
// application.modules = "Index,Home,Admin" in conf/application.ini
Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->setDefaultModule("Home");

$app->run();
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setDefaultController</methodname></member>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setDefaultAction</methodname></member>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getDefaultModule</methodname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.seterrorhandler" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setErrorHandler</refname>
  <refpurpose>Set error handler</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Dispatcher</type><type>null</type><type>false</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setErrorHandler</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>mixed</type><parameter>callback</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>int</type><parameter>error_types</parameter><initializer>0</initializer></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Set an error handler for Yaf. When
   <link linkend="configuration.yaf.dispatcher.throwexception">application.dispatcher.throwException</link>
   is off, Yaf triggers catchable errors when unexpected errors occur.
  </simpara>
  <simpara>
   This method is a wrapper of <function>set_error_handler</function>;
   the handler is called whenever such an error is raised.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>callback</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      A callable callback, with the same semantics as the callback passed
      to <function>set_error_handler</function>.     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>error_types</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      The error types to handle, same as the
      <parameter>error_levels</parameter> parameter of
      <function>set_error_handler</function>. Defaults to handling all error types.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns the <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> object itself on
   success, &false; if calling <function>set_error_handler</function> failed,
   or &null; if the application is not initialized.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setErrorHandler</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$app = new Yaf_Application(dirname(__FILE__) . "/conf/application.ini");

Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->setErrorHandler(function ($errno, $errstr) {
    // Route errors to ErrorController::errorAction
    $request = Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->getRequest();
    $request->setControllerName("Error");
    $request->setActionName("error");
});

$app->run();
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::throwException</methodname></member>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Application::getLastErrorNo</methodname></member>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Application::getLastErrorMsg</methodname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.setrequest" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setRequest</refname>
  <refpurpose>Set the request object</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Dispatcher</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setRequest</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><parameter>request</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Set the request object used by the dispatcher. This allows using a
   custom request implementation instead of the built-in
   <classname>Yaf_Request_Http</classname> or
   <classname>Yaf_Request_Simple</classname>.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>request</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      A <classname>Yaf_Request_Abstract</classname> instance.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns the <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> object itself on
   success, or &null; if the application is not initialized.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setRequest</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$app = new Yaf_Application(dirname(__FILE__) . "/conf/application.ini");

// Run the application from a cron job:
// $ php cron.php index/index/cleanup
$request = new Yaf_Request_Simple("CLI");

Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->setRequest($request);

$app->run();
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getRequest</methodname></member>
    <member><classname>Yaf_Request_Abstract</classname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.setresponse" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setResponse</refname>
  <refpurpose>Set the response object</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Dispatcher</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setResponse</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Response_Abstract</type><parameter>response</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Set the response object used by the dispatcher. This allows using a
   custom response implementation instead of the built-in ones.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>response</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      A <classname>Yaf_Response_Abstract</classname> instance.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns the <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> object itself on
   success, or &null; if the application is not initialized.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setResponse</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class ApiResponse extends Yaf_Response_Http
{
    public function response()
    {
        header("Content-Type: application/json");
        parent::response();
    }
}

$app = new Yaf_Application(dirname(__FILE__) . "/conf/application.ini");

Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->setResponse(new ApiResponse());

$app->run();
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getResponse</methodname></member>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setRequest</methodname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.setview" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setView</refname>
  <refpurpose>Set a custom view engine</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Dispatcher</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setView</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_View_Interface</type><parameter>view</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
     This method provides a solution if you want use a custom view
     engine instead of <classname>Yaf_View_Simple</classname>
  </para>

 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>view</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
       A <classname>Yaf_View_Interface</classname> instance
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns the <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> object itself on
   success, or &null; if the application is not initialized.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title>A custom View engine example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
require "/path/to/smarty/Smarty.class.php";

class Smarty_Adapter implements Yaf_View_Interface
{
    /**
     * Smarty object
     * @var Smarty
     */
    public $_smarty;
 
    /**
     * Constructor
     *
     * @param string $tmplPath
     * @param array $extraParams
     * @return void
     */
    public function __construct($tmplPath = null, $extraParams = array()) {
        $this->_smarty = new Smarty;
 
        if (null !== $tmplPath) {
            $this->setScriptPath($tmplPath);
        }
 
        foreach ($extraParams as $key => $value) {
            $this->_smarty->$key = $value;
        }
    }
 
    /**
     * Set the path to the templates
     *
     * @param string $path The directory to set as the path.
     * @return void
     */
    public function setScriptPath($path)
    {
        if (is_readable($path)) {
            $this->_smarty->template_dir = $path;
            return;
        }
 
        throw new Exception('Invalid path provided');
    }
 
    /**
     * Assign a variable to the template
     *
     * @param string $key The variable name.
     * @param mixed $val The variable value.
     * @return void
     */
    public function __set($key, $val)
    {
        $this->_smarty->assign($key, $val);
    }
 
    /**
     * Allows testing with empty() and isset() to work
     *
     * @param string $key
     * @return boolean
     */
    public function __isset($key)
    {
        return (null !== $this->_smarty->get_template_vars($key));
    }
 
    /**
     * Allows unset() on object properties to work
     *
     * @param string $key
     * @return void
     */
    public function __unset($key)
    {
        $this->_smarty->clear_assign($key);
    }
 
    /**
     * Assign variables to the template
     *
     * Allows setting a specific key to the specified value, OR passing
     * an array of key => value pairs to set en masse.
     *
     * @see __set()
     * @param string|array $spec The assignment strategy to use (key or
     * array of key => value pairs)
     * @param mixed $value (Optional) If assigning a named variable,
     * use this as the value.
     * @return void
     */
    public function assign($spec, $value = null) {
        if (is_array($spec)) {
            $this->_smarty->assign($spec);
            return;
        }
 
        $this->_smarty->assign($spec, $value);
    }
 
    /**
     * Clear all assigned variables
     *
     * Clears all variables assigned to Yaf_View either via
     * {@link assign()} or property overloading
     * ({@link __get()}/{@link __set()}).
     *
     * @return void
     */
    public function clearVars() {
        $this->_smarty->clear_all_assign();
    }
 
    /**
     * Processes a template and returns the output.
     *
     * @param string $name The template to process.
     * @return string The output.
     */
    public function render($name, $value = NULL) {
        return $this->_smarty->fetch($name);
    }

    public function display($name, $value = NULL) {
        echo $this->_smarty->fetch($name);
    }

}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
  <example>
   <title><function>Yaf_Dispatcher::setView</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class Bootstrap extends Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract {

    /**
     * there are some config for smarty in the config:
     *
     * smarty.left_delimiter   = "{{"
     * smarty.right_delimiter  = "}}"
     * smarty.template_dir     = APPLICATION_PATH "/views/scripts/"
     * smarty.compile_dir      = APPLICATION_PATH "/views/templates_c/"
     * smarty.cache_dir        = APPLICATION_PATH "/views/templates_d/"
     *
     */
    public function _initConfig() {
        $config = Yaf_Application::app()->getConfig();
        Yaf_Registry::set("config", $config);
    }

    public function _initLocalName() {
        /** we put class Smarty_Adapter under the local library directory */
        Yaf_Loader::getInstance()->registerLocalNamespace('Smarty');
    }

    public function _initSmarty(Yaf_Dispatcher $dispatcher) {
        $smarty = new Smarty_Adapter(null, Yaf_Registry::get("config")->get("smarty"));
        $dispatcher->setView($smarty);
        /* now the Smarty view engine become the default view engine of Yaf */
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><classname>Yaf_View_Interface</classname></member>
    <member><classname>Yaf_View_Simple</classname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.throwexception" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::throwException</refname>
  <refpurpose>Switch on/off exception throwing</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Dispatcher</type><type>bool</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::throwException</methodname>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type class="union"><type>bool</type><type>null</type></type><parameter>flag</parameter><initializer>null</initializer></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Switch on/off exception throwing when an unexpected error occurs. When
   this is on, Yaf throws exceptions instead of triggering catchable
   errors.
  </simpara>
  <simpara>
   You can also use
   <link linkend="configuration.yaf.dispatcher.throwexception">application.dispatcher.throwException</link>
   to achieve the same purpose.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>flag</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      Whether Yaf should throw exceptions on errors.
     </simpara>
     <note>
      <simpara>
       Since Yaf 2.2.0, if this parameter is not given, the current state
       is returned instead.
      </simpara>
     </note>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns the <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> object itself when
   <parameter>flag</parameter> is given, or a &boolean; indicating whether
   exception throwing is enabled when it is not.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>Yaf_Dispatcher::throwException</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$config = array(
    'application' => array(
        'directory' => dirname(__FILE__),
    ),
);
$app = new Yaf_Application($config);

$app->getDispatcher()->throwException(true);

try {
    $app->run();
} catch (Yaf_Exception $e) {
    var_dump($e->getMessage());
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
string(59) "Could not find controller script /tmp/controllers/Index.php"
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
  <example>
   <title><function>Yaf_Dispatcher::throwException</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$config = array(
    'application' => array(
        'directory' => dirname(__FILE__),
    ),
);
$app = new Yaf_Application($config);

$app->getDispatcher()->throwException(false);

$app->run();
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
PHP Catchable fatal error:  Yaf_Application::run(): Could not find controller script /tmp/controllers/Index.php in /tmp/1.php on line 12
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::catchException</methodname></member>
    <member><exceptionname>Yaf_Exception</exceptionname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-exception.construct" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Exception::__construct</refname>
<refpurpose>Construct a Yaf exception</refpurpose>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <constructorsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <methodname>Yaf_Exception::__construct</methodname>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>string</type><parameter>message</parameter><initializer>""</initializer></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>int</type><parameter>code</parameter><initializer>0</initializer></methodparam>
  </constructorsynopsis>
  <simpara>Constructs a new <exceptionname>Yaf_Exception</exceptionname>. The <parameter>code</parameter> carries the Yaf error code that identifies the type of failure, and is exposed via <methodname>Exception::getCode</methodname>.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">

  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>

    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>code</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The Yaf error code.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>No value is returned.</simpara>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Exception::__construct</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
throw new Yaf_Exception(
    "Failed to find the controller 'Product'",
    YAF_ERR_NOTFOUND_CONTROLLER /* 516 */
);
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
PHP Fatal error:  Uncaught Yaf_Exception: Failed to find the controller 'Product' in /path/to/index.php:2
]]>

 </refsect1>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-exception.getprevious" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Exception::getPrevious</refname>
<refpurpose>Retrieve the previous exception</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>Throwable</type><methodname>Yaf_Exception::getPrevious</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>This method is inherited from the base <exceptionname>Throwable</exceptionname> hierarchy and returns the exception that was chained as the previous one, if any.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>Returns the previous <exceptionname>Throwable</exceptionname> if available, &null; otherwise.</simpara>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Exception::getPrevious</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
try {
    $previous = new RuntimeException("Failed to open view script", 1024);
    throw new Yaf_Exception(
        "Failed to dispatch the request",
        YAF_ERR_DISPATCH_FAILED,
        $previous
    );
} catch (Yaf_Exception $e) {
    var_dump($e->getCode());
    $prev = $e->getPrevious();
    var_dump(get_class($prev));
    var_dump($prev->getMessage());
    var_dump($prev->getCode());
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
int(514)
string(16) "RuntimeException"
string(26) "Failed to open view script"
int(1024)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>


 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Exception::__construct</methodname></member>
   <member><exceptionname>Yaf_Exception</exceptionname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-loader.autoload" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Loader::autoload</refname>
<refpurpose>Autoload a class</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>bool</type><methodname>Yaf_Loader::autoload</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>class_name</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Load a class by its name. The class name is converted to a file path: underscores and namespace separators become directory separators.</simpara>
  <simpara>MVC classes (classes whose names contain <literal>_Controller</literal>, <literal>_Action</literal> or <literal>_Plugin</literal>) are looked up under the application directory, while other classes are looked up in the library directories: the local library for locally registered class prefixes, otherwise the global library.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>class_name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The class name to load.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns &true; on success, or &false; on failure.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Loader::autoload</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
/*
 * autoload() is normally invoked implicitly by the engine
 * whenever an undefined class is referenced, but it can also
 * be called explicitly to force loading of a class file.
 */
$loader = Yaf_Loader::getInstance("/var/www/shop/application/library");

/* looks up /var/www/shop/application/library/Catalog/PriceService.php */
$loader->autoload("Catalog_PriceService");

/* MVC classes are looked up under the application directory */
$loader->autoload("ProductController");
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Loader::import</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Loader::registerLocalNamespace</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Loader::clearLocalNamespace</refname>
<refpurpose>Clear registered namespaces</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>bool</type><methodname>Yaf_Loader::clearLocalNamespace</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Clear all registered local namespaces.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns &true; on success.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Loader::clearLocalNamespace</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$app    = new Yaf_Application(__DIR__ . "/conf/application.ini");
$loader = Yaf_Loader::getInstance();

$loader->registerLocalNamespace(array("Models", "Services"));
var_dump(count($loader->getLocalNamespace()));

$loader->clearLocalNamespace();
var_dump(count($loader->getLocalNamespace()));
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
int(2)
int(0)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-loader.construct" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Loader::__construct</refname>
<refpurpose>The constructor is private</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <constructorsynopsis>
   <modifier>private</modifier> <methodname>Yaf_Loader::__construct</methodname>
   <void />
  </constructorsynopsis>
  <simpara>Constructs a new loader. The constructor is private; <classname>Yaf_Loader</classname> is a singleton. Use <methodname>Yaf_Loader::getInstance</methodname> to obtain the instance.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>No value is returned.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title>Obtaining the <classname>Yaf_Loader</classname> singleton</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$app = new Yaf_Application(__DIR__ . "/conf/application.ini");

/* the constructor is private; use getInstance() instead */
$loader = Yaf_Loader::getInstance();
var_dump($loader instanceof Yaf_Loader);

/* instantiating directly raises an Error */
try {
    $loader = new Yaf_Loader();
} catch (Error $e) {
    echo $e->getMessage(), PHP_EOL;
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
bool(true)
Call to private Yaf_Loader::__construct() from global scope
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Loader::getInstance</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-loader.getinstance" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Loader::getInstance</refname>
<refpurpose>Retrieve the Yaf_Loader instance</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public static</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Loader</type><type>false</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Loader::getInstance</methodname>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>string</type><parameter>local_library_path</parameter><initializer>null</initializer></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>string</type><parameter>global_library_path</parameter><initializer>null</initializer></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Retrieve the singleton <classname>Yaf_Loader</classname> instance.</simpara>
  <simpara>If the library paths are given, they are applied to the existing instance.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>local_library_path</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The local library directory, usually the same as the <literal>application.library.directory</literal> ini setting.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>global_library_path</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The global library directory. If not given, the local one is used.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>The <classname>Yaf_Loader</classname> instance, or &false; if the loader has not been initialized (which is normally done by <classname>Yaf_Application</classname>).</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Loader::getInstance</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$app = new Yaf_Application(__DIR__ . "/conf/application.ini");

/* Yaf_Application has initialized the loader, so the
 * singleton instance is available now */
$loader = Yaf_Loader::getInstance();
$loader->registerNamespace("Vendor", APPLICATION_PATH . "/library/Vendor");
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Loader::getInstance</methodname> before initialization</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
/* no Yaf_Application has been created yet */
var_dump(Yaf_Loader::getInstance());
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
bool(false)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Loader::setLibraryPath</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Loader::getLibraryPath</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-loader.getlibrarypath" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Loader::getLibraryPath</refname>
<refpurpose>Retrieve the library path</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>string</type><methodname>Yaf_Loader::getLibraryPath</methodname>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>bool</type><parameter>is_global</parameter><initializer>false</initializer></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Retrieve the library directory.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>is_global</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>Whether to retrieve the global library directory instead of the local one.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>The library directory as a string, or an empty string when the global library directory is requested but not set.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Loader::getLibraryPath</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$loader = Yaf_Loader::getInstance(
    "/var/www/shop/application/library",
    "/usr/local/share/yaf/library"
);

/* the local library directory */
echo $loader->getLibraryPath(), PHP_EOL;

/* the global library directory */
echo $loader->getLibraryPath(true), PHP_EOL;
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
/var/www/shop/application/library
/usr/local/share/yaf/library
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Loader::setLibraryPath</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>The local library directory if the class belongs to a registered local namespace, otherwise the global library directory (falling back to the local one when the global one is not set).</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Loader::getNamespacePath</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$app    = new Yaf_Application(__DIR__ . "/conf/application.ini");
$loader = Yaf_Loader::getInstance();

$loader->registerLocalNamespace("Models");
$loader->setLibraryPath("/usr/local/share/yaf/library", true);

/* "Models" is a registered local namespace */
echo $loader->getNamespacePath("Models_Product"), PHP_EOL;

/* other classes fall back to the global library directory */
echo $loader->getNamespacePath("Vendor_Payment"), PHP_EOL;
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
/var/www/shop/application/library
/usr/local/share/yaf/library
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Loader::isLocalName</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Loader::getLibraryPath</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-loader.import" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Loader::import</refname>
<refpurpose>Load a PHP script</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public static</modifier> <type>bool</type><methodname>Yaf_Loader::import</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>file</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Load a PHP script file once. If the file is not an absolute path, it is looked up under the local library directory.</simpara>
  <simpara>A file is only included once; calling <methodname>Yaf_Loader::import</methodname> again with the same file returns &true; without re-including it.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>file</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The file to load.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns &true; on success (including when the file was already loaded), or &false; on failure.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Loader::import</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class Bootstrap extends Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract
{
    public function _initHelpers()
    {
        /* a relative path is looked up under the library
         * directory, i.e. APPLICATION_PATH/library/functions/format.php */
        Yaf_Loader::import("functions/format.php");
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
  <example>
   <title>A file is imported only once</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
/* an absolute path is used as-is */
Yaf_Loader::import("/var/www/shop/application/library/Legacy/csv_export.php");

/* importing the same file again does nothing and returns true */
var_dump(
    Yaf_Loader::import("/var/www/shop/application/library/Legacy/csv_export.php")
);
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
bool(true)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Loader::autoload</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-loader.registerlocalnamespace" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Loader::registerLocalNamespace</refname>
<refpurpose>Register local namespace</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Loader</type><type>false</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Loader::registerLocalNamespace</methodname>
   <methodparam><type class="union"><type>string</type><type>array</type></type><parameter>namespace</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>string</type><parameter>path</parameter><initializer>&null;</initializer></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Register a local namespace. Classes whose prefix belongs to a local namespace are looked up under the given path (or the local library directory when no path is given) instead of the global one.</simpara>
  <simpara>This lets you place your own classes into the local library directory, while shared classes live in the global library directory (see the <literal>yaf.library</literal> ini setting).</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>namespace</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>A namespace prefix string, or an array of prefix/path pairs (when the value is a path string) or prefix strings.</simpara>
<simpara>A prefix only matches at an underscore or backslash boundary: registering <literal>Models</literal> makes <literal>Models_User</literal> and <literal>Models</literal> itself local, but not <literal>ModelsUser</literal>. A leading backslash is ignored, and a class name written with backslashes is looked up as if they were underscores.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>path</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The directory to look up the namespace in. If not given, the local library directory is used.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns the loader instance itself on success, or &false; if an invalid parameter is provided.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Loader::registerLocalNamespace</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class Bootstrap extends Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract
{
    public function _initLoader()
    {
        $loader = Yaf_Loader::getInstance();

        /* Models_User is now looked up in
         * APPLICATION_PATH/library/Models/User.php */
        $loader->registerLocalNamespace("Models");

        /* register several prefixes at once, each with its
         * own lookup directory */
        $loader->registerLocalNamespace(array(
            "Services" => APPLICATION_PATH . "/services",
            "Vendor"   => APPLICATION_PATH . "/vendor",
        ));
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Loader::getLocalNamespace</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Loader::clearLocalNamespace</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Loader::isLocalName</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Loader</type><type>false</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Loader::registerNamespace</methodname>
   <methodparam><type class="union"><type>string</type><type>array</type></type><parameter>namespace</parameter></methodparam>

  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Alias of <methodname>Yaf_Loader::registerLocalNamespace</methodname>.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">

  <variablelist>

    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>path</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The directory to look up the namespace in. If not given, the local library directory is used.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">

<simpara>Returns the loader instance itself on success, or &false; if an invalid parameter is provided.</simpara>
 </refsect1>


 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Loader::registerNamespace</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class Bootstrap extends Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract
{
    public function _initLoader()
    {
        /* registerNamespace() is an alias of registerLocalNamespace() */
        Yaf_Loader::getInstance()->registerNamespace(
            "Vendor",
            APPLICATION_PATH . "/library/Vendor"
        );
    }
}

 * APPLICATION_PATH/library/Vendor/Payment/Gateway.php */

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-loader.setlibrarypath" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Loader::setLibraryPath</refname>
<refpurpose>Change the library path</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>Yaf_Loader</type><methodname>Yaf_Loader::setLibraryPath</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>library_path</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>bool</type><parameter>is_global</parameter><initializer>false</initializer></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Change the library directory.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>library_path</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The new library directory.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>is_global</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>Whether to change the global library directory instead of the local one.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">

<simpara>Returns the loader instance itself.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Loader::setLibraryPath</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$app    = new Yaf_Application(__DIR__ . "/conf/application.ini");
$loader = Yaf_Loader::getInstance();

/* change the local library directory */
$loader->setLibraryPath("/var/www/shop/application/library");

/* change the global library directory */
$loader->setLibraryPath("/usr/local/share/yaf/library", true);

echo $loader->getLibraryPath(), PHP_EOL;
echo $loader->getLibraryPath(true), PHP_EOL;
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
/var/www/shop/application/library
/usr/local/share/yaf/library
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Loader::getLibraryPath</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-plugin-abstract.dispatchloopshutdown" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::dispatchLoopShutdown</refname>
<refpurpose>Hook after dispatch loop</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>void</type><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::dispatchLoopShutdown</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><parameter>request</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Response_Abstract</type><parameter>response</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>This hook is triggered once, after the dispatch loop has finished and all actions have been executed, but before the response is sent to the client. It is usually used for logging or cleanup.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>request</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The <classname>Yaf_Request_Abstract</classname> instance being dispatched.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>response</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The <classname>Yaf_Response_Abstract</classname> instance.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>No value is returned.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::dispatchLoopShutdown</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class AccessLogPlugin extends Yaf_Plugin_Abstract
{
    public function dispatchLoopShutdown(Yaf_Request_Abstract $request, Yaf_Response_Abstract $response)
    {
        /* last hook before the response is sent: write an
         * access log entry */
        error_log(sprintf(
            "[%s] %s dispatched to %s/%s",
            date("c"),
            $request->getRequestUri(),
            $request->getControllerName(),
            $request->getActionName()
        ));
    }
}

/* plugins are registered in the bootstrap */
class Bootstrap extends Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract
{
    public function _initPlugin(Yaf_Dispatcher $dispatcher)
    {
        $dispatcher->registerPlugin(new AccessLogPlugin());
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-plugin-abstract.dispatchloopstartup" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::dispatchLoopStartup</refname>
<refpurpose>Hook before dispatch loop</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>void</type><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::dispatchLoopStartup</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><parameter>request</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Response_Abstract</type><parameter>response</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>This hook is triggered once, right before the dispatch loop starts and the view engine is initialized.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>request</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The <classname>Yaf_Request_Abstract</classname> instance being dispatched.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>response</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The <classname>Yaf_Response_Abstract</classname> instance.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>No value is returned.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::dispatchLoopStartup</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class BenchmarkPlugin extends Yaf_Plugin_Abstract
{
    public function dispatchLoopStartup(Yaf_Request_Abstract $request, Yaf_Response_Abstract $response)
    {
        /* the view engine is not initialized yet, so this hook is a
         * good place to start request-wide bookkeeping */
        Yaf_Registry::set("request_start", microtime(true));
    }
}

/* plugins are registered in the bootstrap */
class Bootstrap extends Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract
{
    public function _initPlugin(Yaf_Dispatcher $dispatcher)
    {
        $dispatcher->registerPlugin(new BenchmarkPlugin());
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-plugin-abstract.postdispatch" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::postDispatch</refname>
<refpurpose>Hook after each dispatch</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>void</type><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::postDispatch</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><parameter>request</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Response_Abstract</type><parameter>response</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>This hook is triggered after each dispatch iteration finishes, i.e. after the action has been executed. Like <methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::preDispatch</methodname>, it may be called more than once per request.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>request</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The <classname>Yaf_Request_Abstract</classname> instance being dispatched.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>response</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The <classname>Yaf_Response_Abstract</classname> instance.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>No value is returned.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::postDispatch</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class BenchmarkPlugin extends Yaf_Plugin_Abstract
{
    public function postDispatch(Yaf_Request_Abstract $request, Yaf_Response_Abstract $response)
    {
        /* the action has been executed: append some debug
         * information to the response body */
        $elapsed = microtime(true) - Yaf_Registry::get("request_start");
        $response->appendBody(sprintf(
            "\n<!-- rendered in %.3f seconds -->",
            $elapsed
        ));
    }
}

/* plugins are registered in the bootstrap */
class Bootstrap extends Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract
{
    public function _initPlugin(Yaf_Dispatcher $dispatcher)
    {
        $dispatcher->registerPlugin(new BenchmarkPlugin());
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-plugin-abstract.predispatch" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::preDispatch</refname>
<refpurpose>Hook before each dispatch</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>void</type><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::preDispatch</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><parameter>request</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Response_Abstract</type><parameter>response</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>This hook is triggered before each dispatch iteration in the dispatch loop. A dispatch loop may run several iterations, so this hook may be called more than once per request.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>request</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The <classname>Yaf_Request_Abstract</classname> instance being dispatched.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>response</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The <classname>Yaf_Response_Abstract</classname> instance.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>No value is returned.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::preDispatch</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class LayoutPlugin extends Yaf_Plugin_Abstract
{
    public function preDispatch(Yaf_Request_Abstract $request, Yaf_Response_Abstract $response)
    {
        /* pick the template directory based on the module, right
         * before the action is dispatched */
        $view = Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->getView();
        if ($request->getModuleName() == "Admin") {
            $view->setScriptPath(APPLICATION_PATH . "/modules/admin/views");
        }
    }
}

/* plugins are registered in the bootstrap */
class Bootstrap extends Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract
{
    public function _initPlugin(Yaf_Dispatcher $dispatcher)
    {
        $dispatcher->registerPlugin(new LayoutPlugin());
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>
