<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-plugin-abstract.preresponse" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::preResponse</refname>
<refpurpose>Hook before the response is sent</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>void</type><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::preResponse</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><parameter>request</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Response_Abstract</type><parameter>response</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>This hook is intended to be triggered before the response is sent to the client.</simpara>
  <warning>
   <simpara>As of this version this hook is never called: it is registered on <classname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract</classname> but not wired into the dispatch flow. Overriding it has no effect.</simpara>
  </warning>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>request</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The <classname>Yaf_Request_Abstract</classname> instance being dispatched.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>response</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The <classname>Yaf_Response_Abstract</classname> instance.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>No value is returned.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::preResponse</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class MinifyPlugin extends Yaf_Plugin_Abstract
{
    public function preResponse(Yaf_Request_Abstract $request, Yaf_Response_Abstract $response)
    {
        /* meant to minify the body right before it is sent; note
         * that, as of this version, this hook is never actually
         * called */
        $response->setBody(
            preg_replace("/>\s+</", "><", $response->getBody())
        );
    }
}

/* plugins are registered in the bootstrap */
class Bootstrap extends Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract
{
    public function _initPlugin(Yaf_Dispatcher $dispatcher)
    {
        $dispatcher->registerPlugin(new MinifyPlugin());
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-plugin-abstract.routershutdown" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::routerShutdown</refname>
<refpurpose>Hook after routing</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>void</type><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::routerShutdown</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><parameter>request</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Response_Abstract</type><parameter>response</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>This hook is triggered after the routing process has finished and the controller and action names have been resolved, but before the dispatch loop starts. It is usually used for access control checks such as a login check, because the target controller and action are already known.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>request</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The <classname>Yaf_Request_Abstract</classname> instance being dispatched.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>response</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The <classname>Yaf_Response_Abstract</classname> instance.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>No value is returned.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::routerShutdown</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class AuthPlugin extends Yaf_Plugin_Abstract
{
    public function routerShutdown(Yaf_Request_Abstract $request, Yaf_Response_Abstract $response)
    {
        /* routing is done, so the target controller and action are
         * known: check whether the user may access them */
        $public = array("Index" => array("index"), "User" => array("login"));

        $controller = $request->getControllerName();
        $action = $request->getActionName();

        if (isset($public[$controller]) && in_array($action, $public[$controller])) {
            return;
        }

        if (!Yaf_Session::getInstance()->has("login")) {
            $response->setRedirect("/user/login");
            $request->setDispatched(true); // do not dispatch the request
        }
    }
}

/* plugins are registered in the bootstrap */
class Bootstrap extends Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract
{
    public function _initPlugin(Yaf_Dispatcher $dispatcher)
    {
        $dispatcher->registerPlugin(new AuthPlugin());
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::routerStartup</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::dispatchLoopStartup</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::preDispatch</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::postDispatch</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::dispatchLoopShutdown</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::preResponse</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-plugin-abstract.routerstartup" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::routerStartup</refname>
<refpurpose>Hook before routing</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>void</type><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::routerStartup</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><parameter>request</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Response_Abstract</type><parameter>response</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>This hook is triggered right before the request is routed. It is the earliest hook in the dispatch flow, so it is usually used for URL rewriting or for routing decisions that must happen before <classname>Yaf_Router::route</classname> runs.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>request</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The <classname>Yaf_Request_Abstract</classname> instance being dispatched.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>response</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The <classname>Yaf_Response_Abstract</classname> instance.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>No value is returned.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::routerStartup</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class RewritePlugin extends Yaf_Plugin_Abstract
{
    public function routerStartup(Yaf_Request_Abstract $request, Yaf_Response_Abstract $response)
    {
        /* rewrite "/about" style URIs to "/page/about" before
         * routing runs */
        $uri = $request->getRequestUri();
        if (preg_match("#^/[a-z]+$#", $uri)) {
            $request->setRequestUri("/page" . $uri);
        }
    }
}

/* plugins are registered in the bootstrap */
class Bootstrap extends Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract
{
    public function _initPlugin(Yaf_Dispatcher $dispatcher)
    {
        $dispatcher->registerPlugin(new RewritePlugin());
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;

   <member><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::dispatchLoopStartup</methodname></member>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-registry.construct" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Registry::__construct</refname>
<refpurpose>Constructor of Yaf_Registry</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <constructorsynopsis>
   <modifier>private</modifier><methodname>Yaf_Registry::__construct</methodname>
   <void />
  </constructorsynopsis>
  <simpara>The constructor is private: <classname>Yaf_Registry</classname> implements the singleton pattern and cannot be instantiated directly. Use the static methods to read and write registry entries.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>No value is returned.</simpara>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Registry::__construct</methodname> example</title>
   <simpara>
    The constructor is private, so direct instantiation is rejected:
   </simpara>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$registry = new Yaf_Registry();
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
PHP Fatal error:  Uncaught Error: Call to private Yaf_Registry::__construct() from invalid context
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
  <example>
   <title>Using <classname>Yaf_Registry</classname> through its static methods</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
Yaf_Registry::set("version", Yaf_Application::app()->getConfig()->application->version);
var_dump(Yaf_Registry::get("version"));
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
string(7) "1.0.0.1"
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Registry::set</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Registry::get</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Registry::has</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-registry.del" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Registry::del</refname>
<refpurpose>Remove an item from registry</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <modifier>static</modifier> <type>bool</type><methodname>Yaf_Registry::del</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>name</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Removes an entry from the registry. Removing a name that does not exist is silently accepted.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The name of the registry entry.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Always returns &true;.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Registry::del</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
Yaf_Registry::set("redis", new Redis());
var_dump(Yaf_Registry::has("redis"));

var_dump(Yaf_Registry::del("redis"));
var_dump(Yaf_Registry::has("redis"));

/* deleting a missing entry is silently accepted */
var_dump(Yaf_Registry::del("redis"));
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
bool(true)
bool(true)
bool(false)
bool(true)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Registry::get</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Registry::set</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Registry::has</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-registry.get" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Registry::get</refname>
<refpurpose>Retrieve an item from registry</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <modifier>static</modifier> <type>mixed</type><methodname>Yaf_Registry::get</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>name</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Retrieves a value from the registry.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The name of the registry entry.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>The value stored under <parameter>name</parameter>, or &null; if there is no entry with that name.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Registry::get</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class IndexController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function indexAction()
    {
        $redis = Yaf_Registry::get("redis");
        if ($redis === null) {
            throw new Exception("the redis connection is not registered");
        }

        $this->getView()->assign("visits", $redis->get("site:visits"));

        return true;
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Registry::set</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Registry::has</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Registry::del</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-registry.has" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Registry::has</refname>
<refpurpose>Check whether an item exists</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <modifier>static</modifier> <type>bool</type><methodname>Yaf_Registry::has</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>name</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Checks whether a value exists in the registry.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The name of the registry entry.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns &true; if an entry with the given name exists, &false; otherwise.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Registry::has</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class Bootstrap extends Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract
{
    public function _initRedis(Yaf_Dispatcher $dispatcher)
    {
        /* skip the work if a previous bootstrap pass already did it */
        if (Yaf_Registry::has("redis")) {
            return;
        }

        $config = Yaf_Application::app()->getConfig()->redis;

        $redis = new Redis();
        $redis->connect($config->host, $config->port);

        Yaf_Registry::set("redis", $redis);
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;

   <member><methodname>Yaf_Registry::get</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Registry::set</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Registry::del</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-registry.set" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Registry::set</refname>
<refpurpose>Add an item into registry</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <modifier>static</modifier> <type>bool</type><methodname>Yaf_Registry::set</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>name</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam><type>mixed</type><parameter>value</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Stores a value in the registry. Setting an already existing name overwrites its previous value.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The name of the registry entry.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>value</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The value to store; it may be of any type, including objects.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns &true; on success, or &false; on failure.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Registry::set</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class Bootstrap extends Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract
{
    public function _initRedis(Yaf_Dispatcher $dispatcher)
    {
        $config = Yaf_Application::app()->getConfig()->redis;

        $redis = new Redis();
        $redis->connect($config->host, $config->port);

        /* the connection is now available to the whole application */
        Yaf_Registry::set("redis", $redis);
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Registry::get</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Registry::has</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Registry::del</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-request-abstract.clearparams" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::clearParams</refname>
<refpurpose>Remove all parameters</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::clearParams</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Remove all parameters set by the router, or by <methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setParam</methodname>.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns the request object itself.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::clearParams</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class IndexController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function indexAction()
    {
        $request = $this->getRequest();

        $request->setParam("referrer", "newsletter");
        var_dump($request->getParam("referrer"));

        $request->clearParams();
        var_dump($request->getParam("referrer"));
    }
}
?>]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
string(10) "newsletter"
NULL]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setParam</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getParam</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getParams</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-request-abstract.get" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::get</refname>
<refpurpose>Retrieve a variable from the request</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>mixed</type><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::get</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>name</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>mixed</type><parameter>default</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Retrieves a variable from the request. The search order is: request parameters set by <methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::setParam</methodname>, then POST, GET, COOKIE, SERVER.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The variable name.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>default</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The value to return if the variable is not found.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>The value if found, or <parameter>default</parameter> if it was provided, &null; otherwise.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::get</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class SearchController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function indexAction()
    {
        $request = $this->getRequest();

        // Assuming the request is /search?keyword=yaf&page=2
        $keyword = $request->get("keyword");
        $page    = (int) $request->get("page", 1);
        $sort    = $request->get("sort", "relevance");

        var_dump($keyword, $page, $sort);
    }
}
?>]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
string(3) "yaf"
int(2)
string(9) "relevance"
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getQuery</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getRequest</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getPost</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getCookie</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getFiles</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getParam</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

 <refsect1 role="description">

 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>The base URI, or an empty string if not set.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getBaseUri</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class IndexController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function indexAction()
    {
        $request = $this->getRequest();

        // Assuming the application is served under /myapp,
        // and the request is /myapp/product/view
        var_dump($request->getBaseUri());
        var_dump($request->getRequestUri());
    }
}
?>]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
string(6) "/myapp"
string(19) "/myapp/product/view"
]]>
   </screen>

   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>mixed</type><parameter>default</parameter></methodparam>

  <simpara>Retrieves a variable from $_COOKIE.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The variable name. If omitted, the whole array is returned.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>default</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The value to return if the variable is not found.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>The cookie value, or <parameter>default</parameter> if it is not set.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getCookie</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class UserController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function profileAction()
    {
        $request = $this->getRequest();

        $theme     = $request->getCookie("theme", "light");
        $sessionId = $request->getCookie("sid");

        var_dump($theme, $sessionId);
    }
}
?>]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
string(4) "dark"
string(8) "1f2a3b4c"
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>

<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-request-abstract.getexception" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getException</refname>
  <refpurpose>Retrieve the exception</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Exception</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getException</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Retrieve the exception caught during dispatching.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>The <exceptionname>Exception</exceptionname> caught during dispatching, or &null; if none.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getException</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
// In the bootstrap, enable exception catching so that any exception
// thrown during dispatching is forwarded to the error action
Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->catchException(true);

class ErrorController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function errorAction($exception)
    {
        var_dump($this->getRequest()->getException() === $exception);
    }
}
?>]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
bool(true)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::catchException</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="yaf-request-abstract.getfiles" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getFiles</refname>
<refpurpose>Fetch uploaded files</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>mixed</type><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getFiles</methodname>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>string</type><parameter>name</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>mixed</type><parameter>default</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Retrieves a variable from $_FILES.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The variable name. If omitted, the whole array is returned.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>default</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The value to return if the variable is not found.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>The uploaded files array, or <parameter>default</parameter> if it is not set.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getFiles</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class UploadController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function saveAction()
    {
        $file = $this->getRequest()->getFiles("avatar");

        if (is_array($file) && $file["error"] === UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
            move_uploaded_file(
                $file["tmp_name"],
                "/var/www/uploads/" . basename($file["name"])
            );
        }
    }
}
?>]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getFiles</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class UploadController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function saveAction()
    {
        // Assuming a file was uploaded with the form field name "avatar"
        var_dump($this->getRequest()->getFiles("avatar"));
    }
}
?>]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
array(5) {
  ["name"]=>
  string(9) "photo.jpg"
  ["type"]=>
  string(10) "image/jpeg"
  ["tmp_name"]=>
  string(14) "/tmp/phpXvBXqZ"
  ["error"]=>
  int(0)
  ["size"]=>
  int(12455)
}
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>
